scripts.diagrams: for f in src/assets/diagrams/*.mmd; do npx --yes @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i "$f" -o "${f%.mmd}-dark.svg" -c src/assets/diagrams/mermaid-config-dark.json --backgroundColor transparent; npx --yes @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i "$f" -o "${f%.mmd}-light.svg" -c src/assets/diagrams/mermaid-config-light.json --backgroundColor transparent; done
scripts.diagrams:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const mmds=fs.readdirSync('src/assets/diagrams').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.mmd'));const missing=mmds.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync('src/assets/diagrams/'+f.replace('.mmd','-dark.svg'))||!fs.existsSync('src/assets/diagrams/'+f.replace('.mmd','-light.svg')));if(missing.length){console.log('Regenerating diagrams...');process.exit(1)}else{console.log('SVGs up to date, skipping diagram generation')}"
scripts.diagrams:auto: npm run diagrams:check || npm run diagrams
